title: Brand the site
description: Set the name, links, logo, and color tokens in brand.json. One file controls every visible identity detail.

sections.title: Name and links
paragraphs: name is used in titles and prompts; wordmark is shown in the header. homepage is where the back links point, and repository plus branch build the edit and source links.

sections.title: Logo and social image
paragraphs: Replace public/logo.svg and public/og.svg. Keep the logo square; it renders at 25 pixels in the header and as the favicon.

sections.title: Color tokens
paragraphs: Each key in theme becomes a CSS custom property on the root element. The defaults reproduce the reference palette; change them together so contrast stays readable.
table: Body text, secondary text, quiet labels
Page background, cards and code, dividers
Focus rings, active links, diagram arrows

sections.title: Header, groups, and search
paragraphs: nav lists header links. groups sets sidebar order; a page whose group is missing from the list will not appear in the sidebar. popular lists the pages shown before a reader types a search query.
